title: Toho's Godzilla Minus Zero (dir. Takashi Yamazaki), sequel to the Oscar-winning Godzilla Minus One, opens in Indian cinemas including IMAX on Fri 20 Nov 2026 via PVR INOX Pictures with Toho (confirmed by PVR INOX Pictures' Nayana Bijli to Bollywood Hungama, 11 Nov), two weeks after its 6 Nov North American opening because Ramayana: Part One holds India's IMAX screens for its first two weeks; it opened at No. 1 in North America with $31.6 million, took ¥910 million on its first day in Japan (the biggest opening day for a live-action film there) and $21.3 million from IMAX worldwide, while Godzilla Minus One never had an Indian cinema release and reached Netflix in India in June 2024.
